source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The Account Hub grid change moves the option image/title/data into explicit grid positions. Review separately requests a distinct fetching appearance and a reduced-motion guard. The landed diff removes the fetching square background/shadow and animates only inside prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference, despite the rows remaining Not Done. This is source-supported adoption, not a visual or preference test result.
title: Keep the fetching icon’s motion guard separate from its static state
